summary: PENN is not lying — the 10-K and Q1 2024 10-Q disclose the Interactive segment losses, the ESPN cash commitment, the covenant relief amendment, the Barstool write-off, and the trajectory honestly. But the framework's narrative-vs-economics gap is large: management characterizes ESPN BET as a 'transformative' growth alliance while Q4 2023 + Q1 2024 burned ~$530M of Interactive EBITDAR, rent ($937.8M) exceeded operating cash flow ($455.9M), and the company had to amend covenants in February 2024 to carve out Interactive losses from leverage tests. The CEO sold ~$4.4M of stock in late December 2023 at $25.25 even as the board ran a $750M buyback authorization. SHORT-tier read on honesty-alpha framing — not for fraud but for structurally impaired economics that the narrative softens; deterministic composite will flag the C1/C2/C3/C10 cluster.
